title_zh: 拉萨各族干部群众学习宣传贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神
title_en: Lhasa Cadres and People Study and Implement the Spirit of the 20th CPC Central Committee's Fifth Plenary Session
summary_zh: 2026年11月，拉萨市各族干部群众通过宣讲、调研、党组会议和座谈会等形式，学习宣传贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神，并部署贯彻落实工作。
summary_en: In November 2026, cadres and residents across Lhasa studied and promoted the spirit of the 20th CPC Central Committee's Fifth Plenary Session through briefings, inspections, Party group meetings and seminars, and set out implementation work.
